blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – Authorities seized P4.56 million worth of alleged smuggled cigarettes and arrested a suspect during an anti-smuggling operation in Malangas town, Zamboanga Sibugay, on Sunday morning. In a report, the Zamboanga Sibugay Police Provincial Office (ZSBPPO) said operatives from the Provincial Intelligence Unit (PIU), in coordination with the Bureau of Customs (BOC) in Pagadian City and other law enforcement units, confiscated 74 master cases and 284 reams of assorted illicit cigarettes at Sitio Tampat, Purok 4, Barangay Lipacan at around 7 a.m. The seized contraband carries an estimated market value of P4,565,664.
